comment: Tools whose job depends on noticing a file change, and the setting that switches each to polling. inotify does not work over the Windows filesystem: /mnt/c is a protocol to a server that never reports a change, so a watch set there is accepted and never fires. Upstream (microsoft/WSL#4739, locked October 2024) is clear that user land cannot fix it, so polling is the whole of the advice. Matched against the command name and against the base name of the first argument, so a script gets the name the user typed rather than its interpreter. Deliberately short: a false positive costs a reader their attention on a warning that did not apply to them.

tools.note: chokidar is what nodemon, webpack, jest and most of the rest watch with.

tools.knob: grunt watch with a poll interval set
there is no flag for this; inotifywait cannot see a change made on the Windows side
tools.note: The only working shape is a polling loop, or moving the files into the distribution.

tools.knob: not usable here; watchman needs inotify
tools.note: Move the tree into the distribution instead.
